purpose: Confirm out-of-sample under fresh variable renamings that the already-merged exact R5 OR-lift/restriction DAG can convert canonical C025 OPEN states to replay-clean UNSAT on structurally unsatisfiable Graph Tautology formulas.

discovery_boundary.development_observation: GT6 and GT7 canonical OPEN -> R5 replay-clean UNSAT; GT8 canonical OPEN -> R5 OPEN due node/depth budgets.
discovery_boundary.confirmatory_scope: Fresh seeded variable bijections of GT6 and GT7 only. This is representational out-of-sample confirmation within already-selected structural families, not discovery-independent family generalization.

construction: one Boolean variable encodes the orientation of every unordered vertex pair
for each vertex v, a non-minimality clause requires some other vertex u with u<v
for every ordered triple (a,b,c), a width-3 clause forbids the directed 3-cycle a<b, b<c, c<a
structural_UNSAT_argument: an orientation of every unordered pair is a tournament
a tournament with no directed 3-cycle is transitive
a finite transitive tournament has a minimum vertex
the non-minimality clause for that minimum requires a predecessor, contradiction
graph_tautology_truth_certificate.independent_generator_certificate: Benchmark code must reconstruct the expected logical Graph Tautology clause set before numeric renaming, apply the frozen bijection, and require exact canonical equality with the emitted CNF. Tiny GT3/GT4 brute-force regression is required, but truth certification for GT6/GT7 is structural rather than solver-derived.

outer_ecology.canonical_UNSAT: preserve replay-confirmed canonical result; R5 not invoked
outer_ecology.canonical_OPEN: invoke unchanged merged R5 from the original CNF
outer_ecology.R5_UNSAT: credit only if the unchanged R5 decisive DAG replay returns UNSAT
outer_ecology.R5_OPEN: remain OPEN; no negative inference outside this frozen representation scope

work_reporting_required: per-family canonical OPEN and R5 UNSAT rescue counts
